decisions.reason: As a multi-item line closely tied to the core natural skincare business and given prominent presentation on its own page, it likely meets at least minimum aspirations or is important enough to retain while results accumulate.

This serum fits existing capabilities and market positioning, and without signs of failure a small established firm would usually keep such a close-to-core product while monitoring whether it reaches aspiration levels.

Although its lighter website prominence suggests somewhat more uncertainty, it is still near the established offer and in a growing industry, so boundedly rational management would more likely continue it than redeploy resources immediately.
